book.name: Galetiya
book.title: GALETIYA MeGaletiya ꞌidi leta Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Hemisa Keliso ꞌoina

Comi meGaletiya yauyauleimi! Taiya hede ꞌobega ꞌiꞌabihe ꞌwanigemiya? Mwalo ꞌaheꞌitegomiya ta nuwami ꞌisabwalena moisa Yesu Keliso weyahina, ꞌabehega keloseya ꞌiꞌamasa, ma ꞌiyamo wanuwanaideya! Coinega wanuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌana hematamatanega ꞌabihetena waloba?
Coinega ꞌaigeda hesilala yahesilalegomi, “To ꞌeda ꞌoinega Yaluyaluwa Tabuna waꞌeweya? Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌana paihowao ꞌoinega? bo Keliso tetelina wahesagoheya ta wahemisaeya?”
Yauyauleimi! Cimi tapwalolo ꞌina hegaina wasanapuya ꞌabehega Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoinega, ꞌoinega geyaꞌabwa watohotoho ma ꞌimi tapwalolo wada losalohi waboi ꞌimi paihowamo ꞌoinega!
Nata togidega ginaula mabwaiyana waloba ꞌasaediya, eeta Keliso ꞌana hemisa ꞌoina waꞌaipate ꞌasaeya?

Caigeda wete hesilala: Yehoba tauna Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌiꞌebwaꞌebwaya ꞌoimiya ta ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌimi paihowa waiwaidi wapaipaihowadi. Togidega ꞌina ꞌebwayaedi ꞌoimiya Mosese ꞌina loinao ꞌadi paihowa ꞌoinega bo Keliso tetelina ꞌana hemisa ꞌoinega?
Wanuwatuhuyahi Ebalahamo ꞌabehega tauna Yehoba ꞌihemisaeya, ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌaneya,
eeta wasanapu Yehoba ꞌana tohemisao ꞌabehega taudi gidemusa Ebalahamo natunao.
Mwalo hene Yehoba Ebalahamo ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Cowa ꞌoiguwega ꞌabwa taudi hali ꞌasa tomotaedi ꞌidi ꞌebe yaliyaya siloba.”

content: Ma Yehoba ꞌina gwae bewa Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌalona ꞌihepwaila nugeteya, ꞌasa ganamuli baibaiwadi ꞌadi ꞌabihebwebweꞌana weyahina, ꞌeguma Yehoba ꞌoina sihemisa.
Coinega tasanapuya tohemisao mabwaiyadi ꞌabehega tohemisaina Ebalahamo baꞌidadiyao ꞌidi ꞌebe yaliyaya siloba.
Ma hesi ꞌeguma taiyawedi sinuwatuhuya ꞌabehega Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌana hematamatana ꞌoinega sibwebweꞌana, ꞌahwa galagalamo nata siloba, weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Loina mabwaiyadi buki bewa ꞌalona ꞌeguma taiya geya ꞌimuliya bwaibwainidi, nata ꞌahwa galagala ꞌiloba.”

content: Moisa, geya sawasawahina ma Yehoba tomota ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegita ꞌeguma Mosese ꞌina loinamo tahematamatane. Weyahina ꞌina gwae ꞌigwaeya,
Ma hesi Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌana ꞌeda hagana, ta hemisa ꞌana ꞌeda hagana. Loina ꞌana ꞌeda Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina bewa gide sileleya, ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Ceguma taiya loina mabwaiyana ꞌihematamatanedi yawasina bwebweꞌana ꞌiloba.”

content: Ta geya sawasawahina loina mabwaiyana tahematamatanedi, ꞌoinega Kelisoina ꞌihemiyalaenegita ta ꞌiꞌabihetegita loina ꞌana mwau ꞌoinega. Loina ꞌana mwau bewa, ꞌeguma geya tada hematamatanediya taꞌamasa, ꞌoinega Keliso tauda weyahida ꞌiꞌamasa gidemusa taudi togala madoudi ꞌadi loheꞌamasa kelose ꞌoidiya. Buki Heꞌasisi mwalo ꞌina gwae bewa weyahina ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Ceguma taiyawedi kelose ꞌoidiya silagudi ma siꞌamasa, toꞌamasaedi ꞌahwa galagala siloba Yehoba ꞌoinega.”

content: Eeta Keliso tauda weyahida mwauina ꞌilobeya.

Ma Yesu Keliso ꞌoinega taudi hali boda ꞌasa ganamuli tomotaedi yaliyaya siloba, gidemusa yaliyayaina Yehoba ꞌigwae hemisaeya Ebalahamo ꞌoina, ꞌabehega mabwaiyada ꞌida hemisega toꞌaha Yehoba ꞌigwae hemisaeya ꞌiꞌebwaegita, beno Yaluyaluwa Tabuna.
Bobolohe weyahina

Ciyagwao, ꞌaigeda ꞌebeꞌita ꞌida mumuga ꞌoinega yaꞌebwaegomi, bewa gidemusa: Ceguma loheya ꞌiꞌiunamo ꞌiꞌamasa, ta ꞌina tobwatobwa nuwana ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌiꞌebwae wahana ꞌoina, ꞌina gwaeyedi geya sowasowana ꞌeta taiya wete weyahina ꞌigwae.
Gidemusa wete Yehoba ꞌina gwae Ebalahamo ma ꞌina susu ꞌiꞌebwaediya ꞌimiya hataya. Geya ꞌabehega Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌigwaeya “Susuwao ꞌoidiya,” ma hesi ꞌina susu ꞌaigeda tuwamo, beno Keliso.

Cana sanapu bewa Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa ꞌilagu nugeteya Ebalahamo ꞌoina, ꞌoinega bolime powa handeledi ma teti muliyetega Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌilatuwa. Ma geya sawasawahina ma gwae hemisaina ꞌiligehi bo nuwana ꞌibui loinaina ꞌoinega, ma hesi gwae hemisaina ꞌina waiwai ꞌabwa ꞌimiyamiya.
Wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌeguma ꞌida ꞌebe yaliyaya taloba Mosese ꞌina loinega, beno ꞌabehega geya Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa ꞌoinega. Geya! Weyahina mwalo Yehoba ꞌigwae hemisa Ebalahamo ꞌoina.

Ma toꞌaha weyahina loina ꞌilatuwa? Loinaina ꞌiꞌabilatuheya ꞌoida ꞌida puiyao weyahidi, ma ꞌoida ꞌimiyamiya ꞌana siga Ebalahamo ꞌina susu tauna Yehoba ꞌigwae hemisaeya ꞌilatuma. Ma loinaina aneloseyao ꞌoidiyega Yehoba Mosese ꞌiꞌebwaeya, ta Mosese ꞌiꞌebwaeya tomota ꞌoidiya.
Ta Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisaina ꞌina ꞌebwaya hagana, weyahina Yehoba tauna ꞌiꞌebwaeya dumwaluweya Ebalahamo ꞌoina.
Cida hemisega Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa natunegita

Geyaꞌabwa wanuwanuwatuhu ꞌabehega Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌiloꞌaleheya Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa. Geya. Weyahina geya ꞌeta wete loina sawasawahina ma yawasida ꞌiꞌebwaegita, bo ꞌida mumugao ꞌida ꞌabihe bwebweꞌanedi. Geya.
Ma hesi Buki Heꞌasisi mabwaiyada ꞌiꞌahwa galaegita, ꞌoinega Yesu Keliso ꞌana tohemisaomo Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa siloba.
Mwalo tutaina ꞌoina hemisa geya tasanapu, tauda Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌipaigita eeta tamiyamwauwa, ma ꞌana siga Yehoba hemisa ꞌigihelatuheya ꞌoida.
Cana ꞌita gide loinaina ꞌiꞌitayahigita ta ꞌana siga Keliso ꞌilatuwa, eeta ꞌeguma tahemisa Keliso ꞌoina, nata Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegita.
Bewa tuwa Keliso ꞌinao pwaima, ꞌoinega loinaina ꞌana ꞌitayahi ꞌoida ꞌigumwala,
ma hesi ꞌida hemisega Yehoba mabwaiyada ꞌiꞌahwa natunegita, Yesu Keliso mahetedai.
Weyahina taiyawedi ꞌomi wababitaiso Yesu Keliso saninega Kelisoina mahetemiu wamiya pwaiya.

Weyahina mabwaiyada Keliso mahetedai, ma geya ꞌeta wete wataha solada ꞌimiyamiya. Coinega meYudiya ma hali bodao mahemahetena, ma babadao ma ꞌidi topaihowao mahemahetena, ma wete meloheyadi ma mewahinedi mahemahetena, weyahina mabwaiyada Yesu Keliso ꞌoina taheboda ꞌaigeda,
ma mabwaiyada Ebalahamo ꞌina susuwao, weyahina mabwaiyada Keliso ꞌina bodao, ꞌoinega taꞌeweya Yehoba ꞌina gwae hemisa, beno Ebalahamo ꞌoina mwalo ꞌiꞌebwaeya.
